trust_decision.summary: Order (re)processing decides that the order's last open payment may have its amount/currency overwritten with the current order total; at the pinned commit this happens unconditionally, with no check on whether a gateway transaction (payment details / payment requests) has already claimed that payment.

landing_point.why: The only place in core that rewrites an existing payment's amount from the order total; a summary of 'payment amount overwrite' leads straight to it.

fix_sites.entry_point: unknown: the source hunks of fix commit 9e9aeaac (#19216) are missing from the fix diff (fix.diff:81-84 holds only the commit title); the other two commits are version bumps (fix.diff:5-79)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: unknown: fix source hunks not available. Candidate (inferred, not confirmed): src/Sylius/Component/Core/Payment/Remover/OrderPaymentsRemover.php:26-35 removes every cart-state payment when the total reaches 0, whatever its gateway state

O3_reason_to_dismiss: A solver could argue the 'cart' processor instance (src/Sylius/Bundle/CoreBundle/Resources/config/services/order_processing.xml:74-80) is irrelevant because core only lets payment requests start on checkout-completed orders (src/Sylius/Bundle/ApiBundle/Checker/OrderPaymentRequestEligibilityChecker.php:22-25), so pre-checkout gateway claims look like a third-party-plugin concern.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: An unclaimed open payment must still follow order-total changes (cart edits, coupons, shipping), and after a failed/cancelled payment the order processor must still create or refresh a fresh payment at the current total. A fix that freezes all payment amounts breaks normal checkout.

O7_producer.where: unknown: the gateway-claim state lives in Payment details written by Payum (src/Sylius/Bundle/PayumBundle/Action/CapturePaymentAction.php:50,62,72) and in PaymentRequest rows created at src/Sylius/Bundle/ApiBundle/CommandHandler/Payment/AddPaymentRequestHandler.php:83; whether the fixed check reads either one cannot be confirmed without the fix hunks

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Zero-total path removes cart payments that may already be claimed by a gateway, with no claim check.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same processor, separate collaborator; a maintainer guarding setAmount could easily forget the remove branch taken at OrderPaymentProcessor.php:47-51.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Changing the method of a 'new' payment whose gateway transaction already started; only checks payment state, not the gateway claim.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same payment-mutation concern (payment rewritten after the gateway took it) in another bundle, using a state-only guard.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Payum capture rebuilds details from the current payment amount only when status is new; a planted variant could re-convert claimed details.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A second, transport-specific implementation (Payum vs PaymentRequest) of 'start gateway transaction from payment amount'.

O9_family: CWE-345 insufficient verification of data authenticity: payment amount is mutable after a gateway transaction is bound to it (business-logic integrity, A08)
